constructor-arg.value: select distinct sub.adsh AS accessionNumber, sub.filed as filingDate, sub.cik, sub.name as fundFamily, ctm.symbol AS ticker, ctm.class_id as classId, td.series AS seriesId, td.value AS strategyNarrative, td.footnote as additionalStrategyNarrative
from sec_financials.submissions sub join sec_financials.text_disclosures td on sub.adsh = td.adsh join sec_financials.company_tickers_mf ctm on ctm.series_id = td.series
where td.tag = :tag AND td.version LIKE 'oef/%' AND sub.filed >= :minDate AND sub.filed <= :maxDate;

INSERT INTO analytics.benchmark_master ( benchmark_id, benchmark_name, benchmark_provider, benchmark_type, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( :benchmarkId, :benchmarkName, :benchmarkProvider, :benchmarkType, :createdBy, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (benchmark_name) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO analytics.fund_master ( series_id, cik, fund_name, fund_family, primary_ticker, investment_objective, strategy_narrative, strategy_type, benchmark_id, benchmark_name, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( :seriesId, :cik, :fundName, :fundFamily, :primaryTicker, :investmentObjective, :strategyNarrative, :strategyType, :benchmarkId, :benchmarkName, :createdBy, :updatedBy, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (series_id, benchmark_id) DO UPDATE SET cik = EXCLUDED.cik, fund_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.fund_name, analytics.fund_master.fund_name), fund_family = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.fund_family, analytics.fund_master.fund_family), primary_ticker = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.primary_ticker, analytics.fund_master.primary_ticker), investment_objective = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.investment_objective, analytics.fund_master.investment_objective), strategy_narrative = EXCLUDED.strategy_narrative, strategy_type = EXCLUDED.strategy_type, benchmark_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.benchmark_name, analytics.fund_master.benchmark_name), updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

select rule_id as ruleId, rule_name as ruleName, pattern, is_regex as isRegex, target_strategy as targetStrategy, priority, is_active as isActive from analytics.compliance_rules where is_active = true order by priority;

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(pl.terse), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(pl.std), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(pl.verbose), ''), nf.measure ) AS benchmarkName, nf.adsh AS accessionNumber FROM sec_financials.numeric_facts nf LEFT JOIN sec_financials.presentation_labels pl ON nf.adsh = pl.adsh AND ( pl.tag = nf.measure OR pl.tag = CONCAT(nf.measure, 'Member') ) WHERE nf.tag IN (:benchmarkTags) AND (nf.class IS NULL OR TRIM(nf.class) = '') AND nf.measure IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(nf.measure) NOT IN (:excludedBenchmarks);

INSERT INTO analytics.benchmark_master ( benchmark_name, benchmark_provider, benchmark_type, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( :benchmarkName, :benchmarkProvider, :benchmarkType, :createdBy, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (benchmark_name) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

SELECT benchmark_id AS benchmarkId, benchmark_name AS benchmarkName, benchmark_provider AS benchmarkProvider, benchmark_type AS benchmarkType FROM analytics.benchmark_master WHERE accession_number IN(:accessionNumbers)

SELECT benchmark_id AS benchmarkId, benchmark_name AS benchmarkName, benchmark_provider AS benchmarkProvider, benchmark_type AS benchmarkType FROM analytics.benchmark_master WHERE accession_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY accession_number, benchmark_name

SELECT rule_id as ruleId, pattern, provider_name as providerName, default_type as defaultType, priority FROM analytics.benchmark_provider_rules WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY priority ASC, LENGTH(pattern) DESC

select fm.series_id as seriesId, fm.cik as cik, fm.fund_name as fundName, fm.fund_family as fundFamily, fm.primary_ticker as primaryTicker, fm.investment_objective as investmentObjective, fm.strategy_narrative as strategyNarrative, fm.strategy_type as strategyType, bm.benchmark_id as benchmarkId, bm.benchmark_name as benchmarkName from analytics.fund_master fm join analytics.benchmark_master bm on fm.benchmark_id = bm.benchmark_id where fm.series_id = :seriesId

SELECT DISTINCT td.series AS seriesId, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(pl.terse), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(pl.std), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(pl.verbose), '') ) AS fundName FROM sec_financials.text_disclosures td JOIN sec_financials.presentation_labels pl ON td.adsh = pl.adsh AND pl.tag LIKE CONCAT('%', td.series, '%') WHERE td.tag = :tag AND td.series IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(pl.terse, pl.std, pl.verbose) IS NOT NULL;
